segments.iti67:2.3: Kāyamoneyyaṃ, vacīmoneyyaṃ, manomoneyyaṃ – imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi moneyyānī”ti.
segments.iti67:3.3: Muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, āhu ninhātapāpakan”ti [āhu sabbappahāyinanti (a. ni.3.123)].
segments.iti67:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.

lines: Aṭṭhame moneyyānīti ettha idhalokaparalokaṃ attahitaparahitañca munātīti muni, kalyāṇaputhujjanena saddhiṃ satta sekkhā arahā ca.

Tividhakāyaduccaritassa pahānaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, tividhaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyapariññā kāyamoneyyaṃ, pariññāsahagato maggo kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyasmiṃ chandarāgappahānaṃ kāyamoneyyaṃ, kāyasaṅkhāranirodhā catutthajjhānasamāpatti kāyamoneyyaṃ.

Catubbidhavacīduccaritassa pahānaṃ vacīmoneyyaṃ, catubbidhaṃ vacīsucaritaṃ, vācārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ, vācāpariññā, pariññāsahagato maggo, vācāya chandarāgappahānaṃ, vacīsaṅkhāranirodhā dutiyajjhānasamāpatti vacīmoneyyaṃ.

Tividhamanoduccaritassa pahānaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, tividhaṃ manosucaritaṃ, manārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ, manopariññā, pariññāsahagato maggo, manasmiṃ chandarāgappahānaṃ, cittasaṅkhāranirodhā saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti manomoneyyan”ti (mahāni.14; cūḷani. mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa 21).
